title: Mark read should allow to mark articles as read for configured time period
summary: The “Mark read” button should allow to mark articles as read for configured time period. For example, offer to mark articles older than 1 week, 2 weeks, 1 month or all. This will help in keeping only recent articles as unread and mark older articles as read.
body_markdown:
# [Mark read should allow to mark articles as read for configured time period](https://forum.newsblur.com/t/mark-read-should-allow-to-mark-articles-as-read-for-configured-time-period/13935)


[idea](https://forum.newsblur.com/c/idea/5)


[maheshc](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/maheshc)


November 15, 2026, 8:17am 1


The “Mark read” button should allow to mark articles as read for configured time period. For example, offer to mark articles older than 1 week, 2 weeks, 1 month or all. This will help in keeping only recent articles as unread and mark older articles as read.
